summary: Enerflex filed a Form 6-K, its routine foreign-private-issuer equivalent of a US current report on Form 8-K, furnishing a news release announcing a major Engineered Systems project award. The Calgary-based company will design, engineer, fabricate and assemble over one gigawatt of low-emission behind-the-meter natural gas-fired power generation units for a large North American data center development, lifting total behind-the-meter backlog above 1.75 gigawatts with deliveries through 2028. No securities, stake, price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation is involved; this is an ordinary commercial order, not a special situation. Watch execution and capex conversion.
